info.title: Nebula.NET Obfuscator (CLI
info.description: Cross-platform .NET obfuscation & hardening CLI (the `nebula` dotnet tool). Renaming, control-flow obfuscation, string/constant/resource/method encryption, reference (proxy-call) obfuscation, anti-debug/anti-tamper and metadata hardening for .NET Framework 4.8 through .NET 10 — for Windows, Linux and macOS / CI. Free edition works with no license key; Pro/Enterprise unlock more. Proprietary — see the EULA.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Nebula.NET Obfuscator by Delta-1 Labs — .NET IL obfuscator.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to the JSON obfuscation configuration file (FR-11).

options.name: --output
options.description: Override the output directory from the config file.

options.name: --input
options.description: Input assembly to obfuscate; overrides 'inputs' in the config. Repeatable. Lets a shared "settings-only" config drive the transforms while the caller supplies the assembly (e.g. the MSBuild integration passing $(TargetPath) per TFM).

options.name: --preserve-public-api
options.description: Override 'preservePublicApi' (true|false) from the config file (FR-22).

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress progress output; still print warnings and errors.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write a machine-readable JSON summary of the run to this file (CI-friendly, FR-90).

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: deobfuscate
commands.description: Translate an obfuscated stack trace back to original names (FR-71).

options.name: --map
options.description: Symbol map (.symbols.json) from the matching obfuscation run.

options.name: --input
options.description: File containing the obfuscated text/stack trace. Omit to read stdin.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Expected original assembly name; rejects a symbol map from a different assembly.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: List an assembly's methods and string literals for selective obfuscation (FR-30/FR-40).

options.name: --input
options.description: Assembly to inspect (.dll/.exe).

options.name: --methods
options.description: List method names only.

options.name: --strings
options.description: List string literals only.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit JSON instead of text.

commands.name: license
commands.description: Show the current edition, issue an online key (--new), or sign an offline license (--sign).

options.name: --file
options.description: Validate this license file instead of the resolved one.

options.name: --sign
options.description: Vendor: sign an offline license file (requires --private-key).

options.name: --new
options.description: Vendor: issue an online license key (creates the Supabase row when given --service-key + --url).

options.name: --licensee
options.description: Licensee / customer name (with --sign / --new).

options.name: --seats
options.description: Seat (machine) count for the new online key (with --new).

options.name: --product
options.description: Product slug the license unlocks (with --new; default nebula).

options.name: --tier
options.description: License tier: pro or enterprise (with --new / --sign; default pro).

options.name: --months
options.description: Subscription length in months (with --new; sets expiry to today + N months).

options.name: --expiry
options.description: Absolute expiry date yyyy-MM-dd (overrides --months; omit both for perpetual).

options.name: --service-key
options.description: Supabase service_role key (the secret). Env fallback: NEBULA_SERVICE_KEY.

options.name: --url
options.description: Supabase project URL, e.g. https://abcd.supabase.co. Env fallback: NEBULA_PROJECT_URL.

options.name: --private-key
options.description: Base64 PKCS#8 private key file (with --sign).

options.name: --out
options.description: Write the signed license here (with --sign).

options.name: --trial
options.description: Vendor: mark the signed license as a time-limited trial (shows a TRIAL badge; use with --sign and --expiry).

commands.name: register
commands.description: Activate an online license key (recommended) or register an offline license file.

options.name: --key
options.description: Online license key to activate (server binds this machine and enforces seats).

options.name: --file
options.description: Register an offline signed license file (legacy).

commands.name: machine-id
commands.description: Print this machine's activation id (used to bind an online license).

commands.name: watermark
commands.description: Vendor: read the per-customer watermark embedded in an assembly (Enterprise).

options.name: --input
options.description: Assembly to read the watermark from.

commands.name: blazor
commands.description: Protect a published Blazor WebAssembly app: obfuscate the app assemblies in _framework and repair the boot-manifest integrity hashes and pre-compressed (.br/.gz) copies so the app still loads (FR-4).

options.name: --framework
options.description: The published app's wwwroot/_framework folder.

options.name: --config
options.description: Obfuscation settings JSON (no 'inputs' needed).

options.name: --assembly
options.description: App assembly to protect (repeatable). Default: the entry assembly.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress progress output.
